title: Two baskets of figs
description: God shows Jeremiah a vision of two baskets of figs symbolizing the fate of those exiled to Babylon and those remaining in Jerusalem. The good figs represent the exiles from Judah whom God will restore and bring back to the land, while the bad figs symbolize King Zedekiah, his leaders, and the rest of the people who will be struck by sword, famine, and plague. [ref:Jer 24:1-10|Jeremiah 24:1-10]
